extraction_warnings: No per-sample metadata table (e.g., Table S1, Table S2, Table S5) content was included in the provided text; only aggregate cohort-level statistics from 'Experimental Model and Subject Details' and STAR Methods sections could be extracted, so granularity was set to subgroup_level (by country and age-group) rather than sample_level.

Age group assignments for 'children' (Ghana, Tanzania) and 'infants' (Ethiopia) are approximate because the reported age ranges span multiple schema age_group categories (e.g., Ethiopia infants range 0.167-4.5 yrs exceeds the Infant definition of <2 years).
Sex fields for most subgroups are aggregate percentages (mixed male/female) and could not be reduced to a single enum value except where 100% one sex was reported (Ethiopia adults).
study_name, subject_id, sample_id, curator, and pmid were not explicitly stated in the paper text and are marked not_reported.
target_condition marked not_reported because these cohorts are healthy volunteers used for microbiome/P. copri characterization rather than a specific disease study.

This paper is primarily a microbial genomics/population genetics study (Prevotella copri); most host-phenotype schema fields (zygosity, BMI, disease details, treatment, obgyn, neonatal, smoker, HLA, FMT, tumor staging) are not applicable or not reported.

Age and disease-status information is only available at aggregate subgroup level (by country and adult/child/infant grouping) for the three newly sequenced non-Westernized cohorts (Ghana, Ethiopia, Tanzania); no individual-level (sample_level) metadata table was provided in the extracted text.
Reported 'age_years' values are subgroup means (with SD), not individual ages; treat with caution as they represent study/subgroup-level aggregates rather than per-sample values.

Disease association analyses (CRC, T2D, hypertension, cirrhosis, IBD) refer to external previously published datasets/cohorts, not new subject-level data generated in this study, so disease field for those external cohorts was not extracted.
Batch 2 returned granularity='study_level', differs from batch 0 ('subgroup_level'); kept batch 0.
Batch 2 subgroups [] differ from batch 0 ['Ghana_adults', 'Ghana_children', 'Ethiopia_adults', 'Ethiopia_infants', 'Tanzania_adults', 'Tanzania_children']; kept batch 0.

This schema appears designed for clinical/oncology studies (biomarkers, ECOG status, tumor size, overall survival), but the paper is a microbial genomics/population study of Prevotella copri with no clinical patient outcome data reported. Nearly all schema fields are therefore not_reported.

The paper does include rich cohort demographic data (age, sex, country) for non-Westernized populations (Ghana, Ethiopia, Tanzania) and disease association analyses (CRC, T2D, IBD, hypertension, liver cirrhosis) at the clade level, but these do not map cleanly to the biomarker/tumor/ECOG/OS schema fields as defined.

No sample-level per-participant rows with values matching schema fields were found in the supplementary text provided; supplementary tables (e.g., Table S1, S2, S4) likely contain per-sample metadata but their content was not included in the provided paper text.
